name: Yukimura Kaori
source:
She is currently one of the most popular idols. She wears her hair in braids and has a cheerful personality, and has appeared on many variety shows.

She has an active and energetic personality. Although she is still young, she has an independent side to her, and is a little doubtful about her current position as an idol.

She often sees Mariko at the station and looks up to her like an older sister, respecting and trusting her.

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=180&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
